cases.prompt: Threat model the upload and processing paths in this repository, including trust boundaries and realistic abuse paths.
expect: The selected scope is mapped to repository evidence.
Runtime entry points, assets, boundaries, attacker capabilities, and existing controls are distinguished.
Threats are concrete abuse paths with justified priority and confidence.
Mitigations point to relevant components or boundaries.

cases.prompt: Review this authentication pull request for implementation bugs and fix them.
expect: The task remains a code review and implementation request rather than expanding into a threat model.

cases.prompt: Threat model this service. The repository does not say whether it is internet-facing or single-tenant.
expect: Only context that materially changes ranking is requested.
If unanswered, assumptions and conditional priorities remain explicit.
The agent does not invent exposure or tenancy facts.

cases.prompt: We found an authorization bypass in this handler. Search the repository for every variant of the same root cause.
expect: The request routes to bug-variant analysis rather than a new threat model.
